source.name: Pennsylvania DEP, Oil and Gas Locations (conventional and unconventional), via PASDA

at_risk.definition: DEP status Abandoned or Regulatory Inactive, with an operator named. (Wells on DEP's Abandoned and Orphan lists are already in the USGS count.)

notes: PERMIT_NUM is county + well number (e.g. 123-22151); the state prefix 37 is added. USGS Pennsylvania wells are DEP's Orphan List plus its Abandoned List; DEP shows 'PA DEP OFC OIL & GAS MGMT' or 'UNKNOWN OPR' as operator on most orphan-list wells, treated as no operator. The download is monthly; update the file name in source.download.

verification.method: Compared the operator joined from DEP's statewide well layer (PASDA) with the operator on DEP's separate Abandoned and Orphan Wells report (cedatareporting.pa.gov), for every USGS Pennsylvania well on that report.
